title: Notification regarding Computer Typing Test under the Die-in-Harness Scheme in the District Courts of Manipur.
text:
KEY LINES:
No. HCMEST-12012/1/2025-ESTT-IISECTION-HCM-Part(1)/ Z,B8 1 : in pursuance of
27.02.2026

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
ImF)ha\, the 10h February, 2026
No. HCMEST-12012/1/2025-ESTT-IISECTION-HCM-Part(1)/ Z,B8 1 : in pursuance of
the earlier Notification dated 5th December, 2025 regarding the compassionate appointment
under the Die-in-Harness Scheme in the District Courts of Manipur, it is hereby informed
that the Computer Typing Test for the concerned persons whose names appear in
Annexure – 1 of the aforesaid notification is scheduled as under:
Date
27.02.2026
Reporting time
12.30 p.m
Venue
High Court Complex
The minimum typing speed for the said test is set at 20 (twenty) words per minute.
Any person who is unable to attend the said test at the High Court Complex shall intimate
the undersigned by email at registrar.hcmimphal@gov.in on or before 20th February, 2026, to
enable arrangement of an alternative venue, failing which no further request shall be
entertained .
All Presiding Officers are requested to kindly ensure that the persons, whose names are
listed in the above-mentioned Annexure – I and who are posted under their control, are
relieved in time to appear for the Computer Typing Test on the above mentioned date and
time
(KH. AIIT SINGH)
REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
Copy to:-
1. The Principal Secretary to Hon’ble The Chief Justice, High Court of Manipur.
2. The P.S. to Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Bimol Singh, Judge, High Court of Manipur.
3. The P.S. to Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Guneshwar Sharma, Judge, High Court of Manipur.
4. The Registrar General, High Court of Manipur.
5. The Registrar (Vigilance), High Court of Manipur.
6. The District & Sessions Judge, Imphal West/ Tamenglong/ Ukhrul/ Churachandpur/
Thoubal/ Senapati
7. The Judge, Special Court (ND&PS)/ Falnily Court, Manipur/ Family Court, Imphal
East/ Family Court, Bishnupur/ Family Court, Thoubal
8. The Addl. District & Sessions Judge (FTC)/ AddI. Sessions Judge (FTC) CAW/ Judge,
Special Court (ND&PS) (FTC) of Manipur
9. The Joint Registrar (JudI.), High Court of Manipur.
10. All the Chief Judicial Magistrate/ Civil Judge Sr. Divn. of Manipur.
11. The Deputy Registrar (JudI.), High Court of Manipur.
12. All the Civil Judge Jr. Divn./ JMFCs of Manipur.
D/The System Analyst, High Court of Manipur.
- He is requested to upload the same in the Official Website of this Registry.
14. The Notice Board/ Concerned file.
. YI-/.
REGISTRAR
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
